property_summary: After any successful payable fallback call that advances time (block.timestamp > pastBlockTime), the reference always sets pastBlockTime strictly greater than the timestamp of that call (pastBlockTime >= call_timestamp + 1), while the mutant can set pastBlockTime equal to the call timestamp; fuzzing caller and a warp timestamp will find inputs where mutant yields pastBlockTime == call_timestamp but reference never does.
change_summary: Set pastBlockTime to block.timestamp (instead of block.timestamp + 1), changing the stored value after calls.
